manifest.name: 网易云音乐
manifest.author: Yggdrasil
manifest.description: 通过你自建的 NeteaseCloudMusicApiEnhanced 服务搜歌、取播放直链与歌词。需要你填自己的 API 地址。

fields.label: API 地址
fields.hint: 你自建的 NeteaseCloudMusicApiEnhanced 地址（默认端口 3000）。一行 Docker 就能起：docker run -d -p 3000:3000 moefurina/ncm-api:latest —— 该服务默认允许跨域（CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN=*）。

fields.label: Cookie（可选）
fields.hint: 填了才能拿到 VIP / 高音质歌曲的播放直链。在浏览器登录 music.163.com 后复制 Cookie 里的 MUSIC_U=... 即可；留空时只能取到免费歌曲。

endpoints.name: search
endpoints.label: 搜歌
endpoints.description: Search songs. Give keywords; returns result.songCount and result.songs[] with id, name, dt (duration in ms), fee (0 free / 1 VIP / 4 paid album / 8 trial-only), ar[].name + ar[].id (artists), al.name + al.picUrl (album and cover). Take a song id from here and pass it to song_url to get a playable link.
endpoints.emptyHint: songCount is 0 or code is not 200: either nothing matched, or the API address / cookie is not set up in the plugin panel. Try a shorter keyword (or the artist name), then check the plugin panel fields. Two attempts is the budget — after that, tell the user what you searched and what came back.

endpoints.name: song_url
endpoints.label: 取播放直链
endpoints.description: Get the playable audio URL of one song by id. Returns data[0].url (put it in an <audio> element), plus br, size, level and type. **url is null when the track needs VIP or is unavailable in this region** — in that case say so instead of inventing a link. A cookie with a logged-in account raises the quality and unlocks more songs.

params.name: level
params.description: audio quality: standard, higher, exhigh, lossless, hires, jyeffect, sky, jymaster

endpoints.emptyHint: url is null: this song needs a VIP account, is region-restricted, or the level asked for is above what the account allows. Fill the Cookie field in the plugin panel (or lower level to standard) and try once more — then report the limitation to the user instead of retrying.

endpoints.name: artist_top_songs
endpoints.label: 歌手热门歌
endpoints.description: List an artist top 50 songs by artist id (take ar[].id from a search result). Returns songs[] with the same field shape as search. Use it for "more songs by this artist" or when the user picked an artist from a search hit.

endpoints.name: lyric
endpoints.label: 取歌词
endpoints.description: Get the lyrics of a song by id. Returns lrc.lyric (LRC text with [mm:ss.xx] time tags), tlyric.lyric (translation, may be empty) and yrc.lyric (word-by-word, may be null). For a plain lyric panel, strip the time tags.
endpoints.emptyHint: No lyrics in the response: this song has none, or the id is not a song. Do not retry the same id — show the track without lyrics and say so.

guide:
# netease-music

Search NetEase Cloud Music, get a playable audio URL, and show lyrics — through **the user's own
NeteaseCloudMusicApiEnhanced server**. This plugin does not talk to NetEase directly.

## Before anything: the API address

Every call needs the `base_url` field to be filled in the plugin panel (the user's own server,
usually `http://localhost:3000`). If a call comes back with "这个插件还没配好", tell the user to fill
that field — do not try to guess an address or work around it.

If `cookie` is empty the plugin still works for free songs; VIP / high-quality tracks return a null url.

## Workflow: "play <song>"

1. `netease-music.search` with `keywords`.
2. Pick a hit by name and artist. `fee` tells you what to expect:
   - `0` free — the playable link should come back;
   - `1` VIP-only, `4` paid album, `8` trial-only — the link may be null or a short preview.
3. `netease-music.song_url` with that `id` (keep the default `level: exhigh` unless the user asks for
   lossless/hires).
4. Build a component: title, `ar[].name`, cover (`al.picUrl`), and `<audio controls src={url}>`.
   Optionally call `netease-music.lyric` and render the words next to the player.

## Rules

- **Never autoplay.** Browsers block sound without a user gesture: always render `controls` and let the
  user press play.
- **Do not fetch the audio bytes** (`fetch_url` / `view_image` on the url). The `<audio>` element
  streams it; reading cross-origin binary is blocked and unnecessary.
- **You cannot hear it.** Your job is the right track plus a working player — never claim you verified
  how it sounds.
- **A null `url` is an answer, not an error.** Say the track needs VIP / is unavailable and offer the
  alternatives (another version of the song, lower quality, or filling the cookie field).
- **Album covers are `.jpg` URLs that accept a `?param=WxH` suffix** — e.g. append `?param=300y300`
  for a sharper cover instead of the default thumbnail.
- Keep one player per request unless the user asks for a playlist.

## Lyrics

`lrc.lyric` is LRC: each line starts with `[mm:ss.xx]`. For a plain panel, drop the tags and keep the
text lines; for a scrolling lyric view keep them. `tlyric.lyric` is the translation (often empty);
`yrc.lyric` is word-by-word and is often `null` — treat both as optional.

## Quality levels

`standard` < `higher` < `exhigh` < `lossless` < `hires` < `jyeffect` / `sky` / `jymaster`.
Higher levels need a VIP account and a filled cookie. If the user does not care, stay on `exhigh`:
asking for `lossless` without the account just returns a null url.

## Failure modes to report instead of working around

- `code` is not 200 → the server answered with an error. Report the code; do not retry in a loop.
- The browser says the request failed → the server is not running, the address is wrong, or its CORS
  setting blocks this page (`CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN`; the default `*` works).
- `songCount` is 0 → nothing matched. Try a shorter keyword or the artist name once, then say what you
  searched.
- Every song returns a null url → the account needs VIP, or the cookie is missing/expired.
